response.justification: The candidate meets the raw experience bar (roughly 15+ years across web, backend, embedded, and infrastructure) and shows genuine engineering craftsmanship, open-source founding experience, and community leadership through talks and workshops. However, the role is a director-level individual contributor centered on AI strategy, requiring recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products or platforms, and experience advising strategic cloud customers. The resume shows only recent, peripheral AI exposure (MCP code generators and agent tooling at re:cinq) and no ML/AI depth, no cloud-platform strategy work, and no evidence of operating at principal/director scope or influencing executive and customer-facing technical direction. Titles cap at Staff Software Engineer, and cloud experience is limited to AWS CDK and Kubernetes as a practitioner rather than a platform strategist.
strengths: Broad 15+ year hands-on record across web, embedded, low-latency, and full-stack systems
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform with real users; entrepreneurial track record
Strong evangelism signal — conference talks, workshops, and courses that show ability to inspire others
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise; no AI products or platforms shipped at scale
No director-level IC scope, technical strategy ownership, or customer-advisory experience
Cloud experience is implementation-level, not platform or future-state strategy

key_factors.factor: Seniority mismatch vs. director-level IC scope
Depth and breadth of engineering experience plus founder background
